    === Section 1: Field-by-field ===
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] globalPosition is in the device coordinate space (origin top-
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] left of the screen / window). It is what you compare against
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] a hit-test result, what you log to telemetry, and what you
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] forward to a drag-handler that wants absolute coordinates.
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] localPosition is in the coordinate space of the box that
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] received the hit. If you put a TapAndDragGestureRecognizer on
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] a 200x100 panel, localPosition is the offset *inside* that
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] panel — so (0,0) is the top-left of the panel, not of the
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] screen. This is what you usually want to drive a custom paint
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] or to compute a drag-relative selection.
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] kind is the PointerDeviceKind that started the gesture. It is
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] NULLABLE on TapDragDownDetails (unlike SerialTapDownDetails
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] where it is required). null means "unknown / unspecified", a
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] legitimate state for synthesised events such as those produced
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] by tests or accessibility forwarding.
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] consecutiveTapCount is the discriminator. 1 = first tap of a
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] sequence, 2 = the second within kDoubleTapTimeout *and* within
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] kDoubleTapSlop of the previous tap, 3 = the third, …. When the
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] user dwells too long or drifts too far, the count resets.

    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] Each subsequent TapDragDownDetails arrives within the
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] recognizer timeout (kDoubleTapTimeout, ~300 ms by default) and
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] within kDoubleTapSlop (~18 px) of the prior tap. If either of
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] those budgets is violated, consecutiveTapCount resets to 1.
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] After consecutiveTapCount reaches its target, the user can
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] move the pointer past kPrecisePointerHitSlop to escalate the
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] gesture into a drag — which is the moment onDragStart fires.
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    === Section 5: Detection flow ===
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   PointerDownEvent  ──► PointerRouter
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   PointerRouter     ──► TapAndDragGestureRecognizer
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   Recognizer wins   ──► onTapDown(TapDragDownDetails)  ★
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]        (this demo)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   pointer moves     ──► onDragStart(TapDragStartDetails)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   pointer moves     ──► onDragUpdate(TapDragUpdateDetails)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   PointerUpEvent    ──► onDragEnd(TapDragEndDetails)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]                      OR onTapUp(TapDragUpDetails) (no drag)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    === Section 6: Cousin types ===
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   TapDownDetails        — plain tap; no consecutiveTapCount
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   DragDownDetails       — plain drag; no consecutiveTapCount
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   TapDragDownDetails ★  — tap+drag combo; HAS the count
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   TapDragStartDetails   — drag has just started (after taps)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   TapDragUpdateDetails  — drag is moving
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   TapDragUpDetails      — finger lifted; tap completed
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   TapDragEndDetails     — drag finished
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   SerialTapDownDetails  — pure-tap counter (no drag escalate)
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    === Section 7: Where TapAndDragGestureRecognizer earns its keep ===
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   * Text editors  : drag-select word on count=2, paragraph=3
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   * Map / images  : double-tap-and-drag to zoom-pan
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   * Sliders       : double-tap to fine-tune, then drag
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   * File managers : tap-then-drag to box-select files
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   * Drawing apps  : double-tap pen for "smoothed" stroke mode
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   * Replaces ad-hoc TapGestureRecognizer + DragGestureRecognizer
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]     pairs that fight each other in the gesture arena.

    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] │ Using transform vs lerp                                           │
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] transform(t) = begin + (end - begin) * t
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] 
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script] For ReverseTween, begin and end are swapped, so:
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   reversed.transform(t) = end_orig + (begin_orig - end_orig) * t
    flutter: [D4rtApp] [script]   Which equals: original.transform(1-t)
